(1) FY2011, FY2013 and FY2014 each print a `MASS WATER POOL 9*` row carrying a FY2024 principal of $418,704 with NO interest cell and NO total cell, which makes those schedules contradict themselves by $418,704. FY2019 prints the SAME balloon payment and prints it COMPLETE: p49 FY2024 reads PRINCIPAL $418,704, INTEREST $0, ADMIN FEE $314, TOTAL MASS WATER POLL TRUST $419,018, and 418,704 + 0 + 314 = 419,018 exactly. Nothing on these pages omits a component. (2) FY2015 excludes two school-construction issues from every year column of its printed grand totals while including them in the TOTAL column. FY2019 does not: the fifteen issues sum to the printed GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL row in 25 of 28 years exactly and in the other three by $1, and to the printed corner within $2 on 213 displayed addends. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: the schedule is a repayment SCHEDULE, not a ledger. It states what the town expects to pay and when; it is not a record of what was paid, and no cents are published anywhere on these four pages, so no figure here can be reconciled to the accounting system. Rule 11 applies to every line: these are gross debt service amounts and the footnote says in the town’s own words that the Mass Water Pollution Abatement Trust payments are `TO BE SUBSIDIZED BY EQUITY EARNINGS AND CONTRACT ASSISTANCE PAYMENTS` -- so what the town actually raises against those lines is smaller than what is printed, by an amount this document does not state.
